paragraphs.text: Connect DeepSeek Harness to the local Sourcebook Desktop library via MCP.

# Sourcebook for DSH
**Keep reusable research, working materials, and notes in Sourcebook across DSH

sessions. Bring selected sources into a task, then hand useful work back for review.**
Use the DSH
workspace for files in your current project. Use Sourcebook Books for references and materials you w
ant to find again across projects: links, files, and notes stay organized in your local library.

## Who it's for
- Video and visual content creators working from reference images, clips, links, and

briefs
- Designers, writers, and researchers who reuse project research and working notes across de

liverables
- People who move between DSH sessions or agents and want useful materials and notes to r

emain available afterward
For example, collect campaign references in a Book, ask DSH to draft a bri
ef from selected sources, then submit the finished brief and its working notes back to Sourcebook fo

r review.
This community bundle connects DSH's built-in MCP client directly to the sourcebook-mcp he
lper shipped with Sourcebook Desktop. It also enables DSH's built-in sidebar browser. There is no se

parate adapter service and no copied pairing credential.
> Independent community bundle; not affilia
ted with or endorsed by DeepSeek. Sourcebook Desktop must be installed and running on the same compu

ter as DSH.
## Bring sources into a task
- Open Sourcebook, check its local service, and choose a Bo

ok.
- Search that Book and retrieve the sources relevant to the current task.
- Prepare explicitly s
elected file sources as temporary context files. DSH can then read them through its normal workspace

tools.
- Open HTTP(S) source links in DSH's built-in sidebar browser.
### Copying link-type sources
When Sourcebook is open in DSH's sidebar, it runs inside an iframe on a different origin from DSH.
The sidebar currently does not grant that iframe clipboard-write permission, so copying a link-type
source with Sourcebook's Copy button may fail with a Clipboard API or Permissions Policy error. To c
opy the link, open the same Sourcebook HTTP(S) address in a standalone browser tab and use Copy ther
e, or select the URL text and press Command+C (macOS) or Ctrl+C. This is a limitation of the embedde
d browser's clipboard permissions; the plugin cannot change the iframe permission. File-source copy

may use a different path and can continue to work.
## Hand useful work back
When DSH creates somethi
ng worth keeping, ask it to propose new text, import a named local file, or update source metadata i
n a Book. The proposals appear in Sourcebook for you to accept or reject; the library changes only a
fter you accept. New text and files can include a note about their origin or intended use, so the ne

xt session has context too.
For handoff to another agent, Sourcebook Desktop's **Pack** copies selec
ted materials to the clipboard for pasting into that agent. Ongoing project materials and one-off ta

sks can stay organized in the same library.
## Try it
- “Open Sourcebook and find the references in

my Launch Book for this project.”
- “Use the selected sources to draft a brief, then submit the fina

l text to my Launch Book with a note about its purpose.”
- “Import this local file into my Launch Bo

ok and open Sourcebook so I can review the submission.”
## Requirements & install
**Requirements:**
DeepSeek Harness with the built-in @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client, Sourcebook Desktop installed and run
ning on the same computer, and macOS. The default helper path in this bundle targets the standard ma
computer, and macOS. The default helper path in this bundle targets the standard macOS app location.
**Download Sourcebook Desktop:** macOS (Apple silicon) DMG — click to download

### DSH Desktop
1. Open DSH Desktop and go to **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin**.
2. Enter the repo

sitory URL: https://github.com/Yanze-He/dsh-sourcebook, then complete the Add plugin flow.
3. Restar
t DSH. Start a new conversation and ask it to open Sourcebook and list your Books. DSH will launch S
ourcebook Desktop and return a local HTTP(S) link; click it to open the app in DSH's sidebar browser

.
### DSH Web profile
Run:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Yanze-He/dsh-sourcebook
For HTTP(S) l
inks returned by Sourcebook to open in the sidebar browser, set DSH's **Link opening method** to **I
n-app sidebar**. Public and loopback HTTP(S) links are supported. The browser rejects file:, data:,

blob:, and DSH's own origin.
## If Sourcebook is installed somewhere else
The bundled patch uses thi

s standard macOS application path:
/Applications/Sourcebook Desktop.app/Contents/Resources/agent-plu

gin/.agents/plugins/sourcebook/bin/sourcebook-mcp
If your app is installed elsewhere, update the com
mand value in cordis.patch.yml to the actual helper path, then install the local checkout into the D

SH profile with:
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-sourcebook-plugin.
